run_saturate_or_goal: run DD breadth-first search until saturation or the geometry goal is found within a timeout
extract_proof_steps: extract proof steps from the built dependency DAG including setup, auxiliary, and log entries

summarize_saturate_or_goal: summarize the saturate_or_goal function that runs DD BFS one level at a time until saturation
